design.scope: Fixed worked-example calibration; no new invariant or general branch claim.
design.selection: Known small shell, common rescaling, exchanged legs, nearby nonshell.
design.prediction: Equivalent representations have identical normalized areas but route-dependent stages.
design.controls: Require a shared square node; reject (3,4,6) before interpreting bounds.
design.holdout: None: these fixed examples calibrate the inspection, not a predictive claim.
design.primary_metric: Completeness and earliest stage of each specified witness bundle.
design.failure_rule: Any missing or inadmissible witness, wrong shared-node test, or disagreement with shoelace fails this encoding.
limits: No intrinsic MoO geometry, area measure, or completed irrational is defined.
Cleared-denominator witnesses are not fractional self-product edges.
Readiness is route-specific; no minimal construction-cost claim.
No pi, trigonometry, or irrational constant is a numerical input.
